notes: POWER is regional context (~50 km), not a field measurement; root-zone wetness is model-based MERRA-2.
Crop demand is ET₀ × Kc, not metered pumping or OpenET.
Historical water and heat comparisons hold the current crop and planting calendar fixed. Water status compares rain minus demand before irrigation.
Daily irrigation timing is unavailable; no daily bucket is inferred from a seasonal total. A reported total appears only at the final chart date.
Crop parameter verification: gdd_to_silking_c and gdd_to_maturity_c depend on hybrid relative maturity; the farmer's hybrid rating should replace them
Crop parameter verification: kc.stage_days come from a non-Great-Plains FAO-56 row; total 150 d vs the 163-d Apr 25–Oct 5 calendar (the last ~2 weeks are field dry-down)
Crop parameter verification: frost_free_days_needed is derived from only 5 years of POWER data at ~50 km resolution
Crop parameter verification: sensitive_window width (±100 °C·d) is a rule of thumb
Fixture management and yield records are synthetic, as labelled in P1 demo_farm.json.

generated_from.note: Computed from real NASA weather and MODIS observations, with P1 SYNTHETIC demo farm records and P4 estimated crop parameters. Historical as-of date uses a recorded crop year; no 2026 crop was invented. Synthetic management and yields are not observations.
